hematemesis

took no medications

concepts.why: The presence of a submucosal lesion with ulceration and a well-defined mass on CT suggests a GIST, although the biopsy results are not conclusive.

rationales.F11: Submucosal lesion in the gastric antrum with ulceration is consistent with both gastric lipoma and GIST, but more specific findings are needed for differentiation.
